title: Moment-to-Moment Affect During Film-Induced Somatic Anxiety: data, analysis code and study materials
description:
Data, analysis code, study materials and manuscript for a preregistered online study (osf.io/s2yvb) in which participants watched a muted first-person heights film (13.5 min) while rating valence and arousal continuously on an affect grid, and completed the STICSA somatic anxiety subscale before and after viewing.

Contents: pseudonymised participant data (questionnaires and 1 Hz valence and arousal time series; no Prolific IDs or free text), the analysis scripts and tests, the rating task and study settings exactly as used, the data-preparation scripts, results, and the manuscript and supplement. The film is a third-party video and is not included.

Licences: data and documents CC BY 4.0; code MIT (see LICENSE). The general rating platform is available as online-affect-rating.
